prompt: Use case: production game cutout sprites. SIX complete standing forest objects, TWO ROWS x THREE COLUMNS of generous custom cells. TOP row left to right: small young broadleaf tree with rounded crown and slim visible trunk; second young tree with taller oval crown and gently crooked trunk; weathered squat ancient stone pillar with moss in cracks, NO writing. BOTTOM row: rustic wooden signpost with two blank directional planks, absolutely no letters; slender clump of forest reeds with beige seed heads; simple rough timber forest exit arch with two rooted wooden posts and a crossbar, open transparent/key-colored space between posts, no wall, no attached ground. Every whole object fully inside central55% of its cell, wide empty spacing, no clipping or overlaps. Front upright billboard view slightly down24degrees. First reference original forest tree and second original forest vegetation define identity, palette and materials. Pet sheets3–4 edge/shading compatibility only. Octopath Traveler HD-2D environment PIXEL ART, restrained earthy moss/olive/sage greens and weathered umber materials, cool desaturated dark hue-tinted edges, warm subtle upper-left key, broad readable color clusters, 3–4 tones/material. No fluorescent greens, candy saturation, smooth vector edges or illustrative microtexture. Upright front billboards seen from 24 degrees above. No baked ground shadows, lighting glow, fog or scenery. Actual engine lighting comes later. Background EXACT pure flat #FF00FF. Keep shapes readable at140–300px body height. No text, rune inscriptions, labels, fog, glow, cast shadows, floors or scene.
source_card: Original forest broadleaf tree and leaves, natural bark/stone/moss palette. Small trees, moss pillar, blank sign, reeds and rough exit arch are required by the forest brief.
